title: Funtown
description: Mod that adds new discs to get into the mood 🎵🎶
body:
🎵🎨 FunTown – Custom Music Discs & Paintings 🎨🎵

This mod brings a creative and immersive twist to your Minecraft world by adding new music discs and unique paintings to discover and enjoy.

✅ Features:
🎶 New Music Discs: Original or inspired tracks that can be found in loot chests, dungeon rewards, or through villager trades.  
🖼️ Custom Paintings: A fresh selection of artwork to decorate your builds and express your style.  
💾 Fully compatible with custom resource packs for deeper immersion.  
🌟 How it enhances your gameplay:  

This mod adds a cultural and artistic layer to Minecraft, perfect for players who love to collect, decorate, and personalize. Whether you're a builder looking to enhance your base or an adventurer hunting rare items, these additions make the world feel more alive, expressive, and unique.

⚠️ This mod is built for Forge 1.20.1 and requires a solid PC setup to fully enjoy the experience.

This mod is still in development and some versions could contain bugs.
